note: The tagged wire tests of pnpm tv:wire (T3-05), read by the e2e app (run-wire.ts) and the runner (scripts/tv-wire.mjs). Each (test, target) pair, in list order, gets the device port basePort + its index, reversed by adb to that pair's recorder on the host. canaryPort is reversed to the mock's canary origin, proxyPort to the global-proxy listener, and closedPort is never reversed. The user, password and canary are fixed test values, not any server's: the recorder swaps the user and password for a real fixture server's, and the mock issues the canary as its token.
